Install opencode-desktop on Omarchy

The open source AI coding agent (desktop app)

The official repository lists this package in Utilities. It was added on 2025-10-18.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add opencode-desktop
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 2.4.1-1:
    pacman -Qi opencode-desktop

Open and use opencode-desktop

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql opencode-desktop

Frequently asked questions

How do I install opencode-desktop on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add opencode-desktop. The download is 176.5 MB and it takes 551.9 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is opencode-desktop free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall opencode-desktop?

Run omarchy pkg drop opencode-desktop. It removes the package from your system.

What does opencode-desktop depend on?

The package declares 28 dependencies: opencode, alsa-lib, at-spi2-core, cairo, dbus, expat, gcc-libs, glib2, glibc, gtk3, hicolor-icon-theme, libcups and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is opencode-desktop in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as opencode-desktop (version 2.4.1-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Anomaly makes it. Project site: https://opencode.ai.
